biography:
Top Secret cleared executive with proven record of results. Expertise in:
Electrical utility infrastructure - negotiation and expedite
Energy delivery contracts and tariff optimization
Air permitting and compliance strategy
Data Center delivery from BOD to customer integration and sustaining operations
End-user energy and sustainability strategy and execution
Change management and organizational optimization
Customer facing facilitation of solutions 
Translate complex engineering concepts to non-technical decision makers

Recent significant achievements:
Led private equity developer of a large data center project in Northern Virginia through infrastructure and energy contract negotiations with Dominion during the recent supply crisis. Through effective use of relationships and process knowledge, both the customer and Dominion achieved success by committing to the delivery of power on schedule so that customer could sign critical customer leases.

Wrote a technical and business analysis for large land owners in Northern Virginia. The product was submitted with the overall business plan to the board of county supervisors for consideration of project inclusion in county comprehensive plan.

Assisted team in delivery and turnover to client of data center project in Texas. 

Negotiation of 100 percent green energy supply for three data centers in Sacramento, CA. 

Negotiation of data center campus energy supply contract in ERCOT. 

Team leader for the attainment of a $100MM contract for cleared data center operations of multi-state facilities for a hyperscaler. Transitioned the Eastern market data centers with new cleared staff and completion of significant maintenance backlog. 

I'm a father to Eagle Scouts and Scoutmaster, Veteran advocate, mentor and builder of leaders.
